title: How a Man of God Walks Away From Sports Betting
caption:
Nobody starts betting to wreck their life. It starts as a five-dollar parlay with the guys. Then it's the first thing you check in the morning and the reason your Sunday goes dark.

Call it what it is. Delete the apps tonight. Tell one brother the real number and let him check in. Then relearn the thing every bet is lying to you about: what God has given you is enough.

"Godliness with contentment is great gain." 1 Timothy 6:6

Send this to the brother who keeps saying it's just for fun.
